title: Fixing a flat bicycle tyre
checked: Every reachable state checked (9 states, 29 with their data, 33 steps). All 3 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 9 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.
The bike goes back on the road only when the tyre holds air.
rules.path: Take away the holds air guard and it breaks in 7 steps: next step, next step, next step, patch it, next step, next step, wait a minute.

rules.rule: A patch comes from the kit
rules.says: Nobody puts on a patch that the kit does not have.
rules.path: Take away the a patch in the kit guard and it breaks in 10 steps: next step, next step, next step, patch it, next step, next step, wait a minute, next step, next step, patch it.
